info.title: Xero Projects API
info.description: This is the Xero Projects API

get.description: Allows you to retrieve, create and update projects.

parameters.name: projectIds
parameters.description: Search for all projects that match a comma separated list of projectIds

parameters.name: contactID
parameters.description: Filter for projects for a specific contact

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Filter for projects in a particular state (INPROGRESS or CLOSED)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: set to 1 by default. The requested number of the page in paged response - Must be a number greater than 0

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional, it is set to 50 by default. The number of items to return per page in a paged response - Must be a number between 1 and 500

200.description: OK/success, returns a list of project objects

post.summary: Create one or more new projects

requestBody.description: Create a new project with ProjectCreateOrUpdate object

201.description: OK/success, returns the new project object

get.description: Allows you to retrieve a specific project using the projectId

parameters.description: You can specify an individual project by appending the projectId to the endpoint

200.description: OK/success, returns the specified project object

parameters.description: You can specify an individual project by appending the projectId to the endpoint

get.summary: Retrieves all time entries associated with a specific project
get.description: Allows you to retrieve the time entries associated with a specific project

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Identifier of the project, that the task (which the time entry is logged against) belongs to

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The xero user identifier of the person who logged time

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Identifier of the task that time entry is logged against

parameters.name: invoiceId
parameters.description: Finds all time entries for this invoice

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: Finds all time entries for this contact identifier

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Set to 1 by default. The requested number of the page in paged response - Must be a number greater than 0

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional, it is set to 50 by default. The number of items to return per page in a paged response - Must be a number between 1 and 500

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of states to find. Will find all time entries that are in the status of whatever is specified

parameters.name: isChargeable
parameters.description: Finds all time entries which relate to tasks with the charge type `TIME` or `FIXED`

parameters.name: dateAfterUtc
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date. Finds all time entries on or after this date filtered on the `dateUtc` field

parameters.name: dateBeforeUtc
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date. Finds all time entries on or before this date filtered on the `dateUtc` field

200.description: OK/success, returns a list of time entry objects

post.summary: Creates a time entry for a specific project
post.description: Allows you to create a specific task

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: You can specify an individual project by appending the projectId to the endpoint

requestBody.description: The time entry object you are creating

200.description: OK/success, returns the newly created time entry

ProjectUser.description: A user who can be assigned to project work

fixedMinutes.description: Minutes logged against this task if its charge type is `FIXED`

minutesInvoiced.description: Minutes on this task which have been invoiced

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes which have been logged against the task. Logged by assigning a time entry to a task

minutesToBeInvoiced.description: Minutes on this task which have not been invoiced

nonChargeableMinutes.description: Minutes logged against this task if its charge type is `NON_CHARGEABLE`

estimateMinutes.description: An estimated time to perform the task

projectId.description: Identifier of the project task belongs to

status.description: Status of the task. When a task of ChargeType is `FIXED` and the rate amount is invoiced the status will be set to `INVOICED` and can't be modified. A task with ChargeType of `TIME` or `NON_CHARGEABLE` cannot have a status of `INVOICED`. A `LOCKED` state indicates that the task is currently changing state (for example being invoiced) and can't be modified

Task.description: A task within a project with charge details

name.description: Name of the task. Max length 100 characters

estimateMinutes.description: An estimated time to perform the task

duration.description: Number of minutes to be logged. Duration is between 1 and 59940 inclusively

dateUtc.description: Date time entry is logged on. UTC Date Time in ISO-8601 format

description.description: An optional description of the time entry, will be set to null if not provided during update

userId.description: The xero user identifier of the person logging the time

taskId.description: Identifier of the task that time entry is logged against

contactId.description: Identifier of the contact this project was created for

deadlineUtc.description: Deadline for the project. UTC Date Time in ISO-8601 format

minutesToBeInvoiced.description: Minutes which have not been invoiced across all chargeable tasks in the project

minutesLogged.description: A total of minutes logged against all tasks on the Project

Project.description: A Xero project with its invoicing and amount details

page.description: Set to 1 by default. The requested number of the page in paged response - Must be a number greater than 0.

pageSize.description: Optional, it is set to 50 by default. The number of items to return per page in a paged response - Must be a number between 1 and 500.

Pagination.description: Pagination details of a paged response

dateUtc.description: The date time that time entry is logged on. UTC Date Time in ISO-8601 format

dateEnteredUtc.description: The date time that time entry is created. UTC Date Time in ISO-8601 format. By default it is set to server time

description.description: A description of the time entry

userId.description: The xero user identifier of the person who logged time

projectId.description: Identifier of the project, that the task (which the time entry is logged against) belongs to

taskId.description: Identifier of the task that time entry is logged against

status.description: Status of the time entry. By default a time entry is created with status of `ACTIVE`. A `LOCKED` state indicates that the time entry is currently changing state (for example being invoiced). Updates are not allowed when in this state. It will have a status of INVOICED once it is invoiced

TimeEntry.description: A time entry logged against a project task

ChargeType.description: Can be `TIME`, `FIXED` or `NON_CHARGEABLE`, defines how the task will be charged. Use `TIME` when you want to charge per hour and `FIXED` to charge as a fixed amount. If the task will not be charged use `NON_CHARGEABLE`
